clues: Of Yusuf and the buyer of the white paint, one took the sponge and the other the spray can.
Whoever took the rag spent less than the buyer of the purple paint.
One of Yusuf and Della bought the black paint, and the other spent $14.
Enzo spent more than the customer who took the roller.
Marta, Yusuf, the customer who spent $10 and the one who spent $14 were four different people.
The customer with the spray can bought either the black or the yellow paint.
Of Yusuf and the customer with the wide brush, one bought the black paint and the other the purple.
The customer with the wide brush spent exactly two dollars more than Yusuf.
The buyer of the teal paint spent less than the customer with the roller.
hints: Start with the white paint. Clue 1 gives its buyer two possible brushes. Does clue 6 allow both?
Next, find the $16 brush and the $14 customer. When the clues run dry, test Yusuf's price with a Suppose: clues 5 and 8 leave him just two.
Suppose Yusuf spent $8. Clue 8 puts the purple wide brush at $10, and clue 2 then needs the rag at $8, which Yusuf already has.
With Yusuf at $12, the wide brush cost $14: Della's. Clue 9 keeps the roller off $8, so clue 4 puts Enzo at $16.

solution.key_idea: Yusuf spent $8 or $12; supposing $8 puts the purple wide brush at $10 and leaves the rag nowhere cheaper, so Yusuf spent $12.
steps: Clue 5 keeps Yusuf off $10 and $14, and clue 8 off $16. So the wide brush (clue 8) cost $10 or $14.
Clue 6 keeps the white paint off the spray can, so by clue 1 white went with the sponge, and Yusuf took the spray can.
The sponge cost $16: clue 4 rules out the roller, clue 2 the rag, and the wide brush and Yusuf's spray can are already out.
Clue 3 puts Yusuf or Della at $14, and clue 5 rules out Yusuf. So Della spent $14, and Yusuf bought the black paint.
By clue 7 the wide brush had the purple. Clue 9 keeps teal off the roller, so teal had the rag and yellow the roller.
Suppose Yusuf spent $8. The purple wide brush cost $10 (clue 8), so the rag cost less (clue 2), but $8 is Yusuf's spray can.
So Yusuf spent $12, and by clue 8 the wide brush cost $14. That was Della, so Della bought the purple paint.
The roller, above teal (clue 9), cost $10, and Enzo, above the roller (clue 4), spent $16. Clue 5 leaves Marta $8 and Felix $10.
solution.epilogue: Della had offered to brighten the pier's spare buoys for the holidays and painted the wrong pile after dark. She bought Nico orange paint and helped him redo every one.
